title: 第7章 后山伐木偶遇灵草第8章 炼化灵草修为沉淀
slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 晨雾缭绕，林间清风吹拂枝叶，发出沙沙轻响。
青岚宗后山连绵起伏，古木参天，草木繁茂。
淡淡的天地灵气萦绕林间，比杂役院院落之中，浓郁了不少。
按照宗门规矩，杂役弟子每日晨起，都要入后山伐木劈柴，供给宗门膳房与各处殿宇日常所用。
往日里，一众杂役弟子都是结伴而行，扎堆伐木，一边劳作一边闲聊，消磨时日。
可今日，没人敢主动靠近林宸。
昨夜以一敌五，横扫赵虎众人的事早已传遍杂役院，所有人都心存敬畏，刻意避让。
林宸独自走在林间小道，步履从容，神色淡漠。
对于旁人的刻意疏远，他毫不在意。
本就无心与这些底层弟子虚与委蛇，独自行动反倒清净自在，更方便自己留意后山地势，探查隐秘机缘。
他沿着熟悉的山路缓步深入，避开了其他杂役常去的伐木区域。
那些地方人声嘈杂，灵气散乱，除了普通林木，再无半点可取之处。
林宸凭借前世修行阅历，一眼便能分辨灵气流转的脉络。
顺着灵气略微汇聚的方向，往后山偏静幽深之处行去。
越往深处走，林木越发高大茂密，晨雾更浓，林间也愈发幽静，鲜少有杂役愿意踏足此地。
一来路途偏远，伐木费力；二来深处多荒草乱石，容易迷路，寻常弟子都不敢贸然深入。
但对林宸而言，此地反倒最合适不过。
无人打扰，清静修行，还能借着地势，寻找潜藏的灵药与灵气节点。
行走之间，他目光淡淡扫过路旁草木，五感敏锐，将周遭分毫变化尽收眼底。
肉身深处，寂灭道体悄然运转，无形中吸纳林间游离灵气，温养经脉气血。
即便不急着打坐静修，只是缓步行走，也无时无刻不在沉淀修为，打磨根基。
这便是寂灭道体的得天独厚之处，无时无刻不在自发纳气淬炼，远超普通凡躯的修行效率。
不多时，林宸寻到一处林木密集的山坳。
此处古木粗壮，枝干坚硬，正好适合砍伐作为柴木。
四周僻静无人，唯有风吹林叶的轻响，格外安宁。
他放下心中杂念，寻起地上一柄锈迹斑斑的铁斧，走到一棵粗壮古木旁。
抬手挥斧，动作沉稳有力，起落之间章法有度。
寻常杂役伐木，全凭蛮力硬劈，费时费力，还容易损耗斧刃。
林宸却深谙发力诀窍，借势落斧，落点精准，每一次劈砍都落在木身纹路破绽之处。
砰！砰！砰！
沉闷的斧声在林间回荡，节奏平缓，不疾不徐。
不过片刻功夫，一棵粗壮古树便应声倾倒，枝干断裂，尘土微微扬起。
他手脚利落，截断枝干，规整劈成木柴，堆放整齐。
content_en:
The morning mist is lingering, and the breeze in the forest rustles the branches and leaves.
The mountains behind Qinglan Sect are rolling, with towering ancient trees and lush vegetation.
The faint aura of heaven and earth lingers in the forest, which is much richer than in the courtyard of the courtyard.
According to the sect's rules, the handyman disciples must get up every morning and go to the back mountain to cut wood and chop firewood for daily use in the sect's kitchen and various palaces.
In the past, a group of handyman disciples would travel together, gathering together to cut trees, chatting and killing time while working.
But today, no one dared to approach Lin Chen.
The fact that Zhao Hu was defeated by one against five last night had already spread throughout the courtyard, and everyone was in awe and deliberately avoided it.
Lin Chen walked alone on the forest path, walking calmly and looking indifferent.
He didn't care about the deliberate alienation of others.
I had no intention of quarreling with these low-level disciples. Acting alone was actually pure and comfortable. It made it easier for me to pay attention to the terrain of the back mountain and explore hidden opportunities.
He walked slowly deeper along the familiar mountain road, avoiding the logging areas frequented by other handymen.
Those places were noisy, the spiritual energy was scattered, and apart from ordinary forest trees, there was nothing to save them from.
Lin Chen relied on his past life cultivation experience to be able to distinguish the circulation of spiritual energy at a glance.
Follow the direction where the spiritual energy is slightly gathered, and walk towards the quiet and deep part of the back mountain.
As we go deeper, the trees become taller and denser, the morning fog becomes thicker, and the forest becomes quieter. Few handymen are willing to set foot here.
Firstly, the road is remote and logging is laborious; secondly, there are many weeds and rocks in the depths, making it easy to get lost, so ordinary disciples would not dare to go deep into it rashly.
But for Lin Chen, this place was the most suitable.
No one will disturb you, you can practice quietly, and you can also use the terrain to find hidden elixirs and spiritual energy nodes.
While walking, his eyes scanned the vegetation on the roadside, his five senses were keen, and he could see every change in his surroundings.
Deep in the physical body, the Taoist Body of Nirvana circulates quietly, invisibly absorbing the free spiritual energy in the forest, warming and nourishing the energy and blood in the meridians.
Even if you are not in a hurry to meditate and just walk slowly, you are still accumulating your cultivation and polishing your foundation all the time.
This is the unique advantage of the Nirvana Dao Body. It can spontaneously receive Qi and refine it all the time, which is far beyond the efficiency of ordinary mortal bodies.
Not long after, Lin Chen found a mountain col with dense forests.
The ancient trees here are thick and have hard branches, which are just suitable for cutting down for firewood.
There is no one around, except for the gentle sound of the wind blowing the forest leaves, which is particularly peaceful.
He put aside the distracting thoughts in his mind, picked up a rusty iron ax on the ground, and walked to a thick ancient tree.
Raise your hand to swing the axe, the movements are steady and powerful, and the ups and downs are measured in a measured manner.
Ordinary laborers rely on brute force to cut wood, which is time-consuming and labor-intensive, and can easily wear out the ax blade.
However, Lin Chen knew the secret of exerting force very well. He took advantage of the opportunity to drop the ax with precise placement. Every time he slashed, he landed on the flaw in the texture of the wooden body.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The dull sound of the ax echoed in the forest, the rhythm was gentle, neither fast nor slow.
In just a moment, a strong ancient tree fell over, its branches snapped, and dust rose slightly.
With nimble hands and feet, he cut off branches, chopped them into firewood neatly, and stacked them neatly.
title_en: Chapter 7: Encountering spiritual grass while logging in the back mountain Chapter 8: Refining spiritual grass and cultivating it
